descricao_original: The duct of the gland stains more intensely than the secretory unit and is composed of a stratified cuboidal epithelium. The secretory unit is a simple cuboidal or columnar epithelium, depending on the secretory activity of the gland. 200x, 400x

bases.legenda_ia: Imagem-base educacional de histologia da pagina 'Eccrine sweat gland', no setor Órgãos e Sistemas > Pele > Associated Structures > Associated Structures 2. Descricao original da pagina: The duct of the gland stains more intensely than the secretory unit and is composed of a stratified cuboidal epithelium. The secretory unit is a simple cuboidal or columnar epithelium, depending on the secretory activity of the gland. 200x, 400x. Este arquivo nao contem os marcadores interativos; use as camadas PNG relacionadas para localizar estruturas. marcadores.explicacao_original: The upper portion of the left image contains two or three ducts which meander through the dermis, thus producing isolated profiles in section. Other portions of the darkly staining ducts can be seen coiled within the secretory units.
